**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1).**

The transition section is internally inconsistent. Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already meet our playbook position on data return (30 days, complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, no fee-dispute hostage) and on certified secure deletion after confirmed return. Section 11.1, however, sits squarely at our walk-away position — immediate discontinuation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — and it directly contradicts 11.2/11.3 as well as the "agreed transition period" that Section 10.1 presupposes.

The redline replaces only the offending sentence in 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, expressly subordinating deletion to the return-then-delete sequence in 11.2/11.3. That is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position; the comment flags 90 days as an available fallback.
